name: Moe ~Moegiiro no Machi~
source:
Winter. Hero lives peacefully in his own pace. But with so many girls around him gradually a new feeling is born.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/11/vn-of-month-february-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
冬日里，主人公一如既往地按照自己的步调平静生活。然而，随着身边聚集起许多少女，一份崭新的感情也渐渐萌生。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/11/vn-of-month-february-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]]
